131026.title: Message not delivered
131026.explanation: The number is not on WhatsApp, the customer's app is outdated, or the customer has not accepted the terms of service.
131026.action: Make sure the number is correct and the customer uses WhatsApp.

131047.title: 24-hour window closed
131047.explanation: More than 24 hours have passed since the customer's last message, so a free-form message cannot be sent.
131047.action: Send an approved template instead of a free-form message.

131049.title: Blocked by Meta
131049.explanation: To maintain a healthy ecosystem, Meta did not deliver the message. This mostly happens with marketing messages to customers who rarely engage with businesses.
131049.action: Try again later, or wait for the customer to message first.

131042.title: Business payment issue
131042.explanation: The WhatsApp Business account is not eligible to send: payment issue, currency not configured, or missing payment method.
131042.action: Contact the account manager to update billing details in Meta Business Manager.

131053.title: Media upload error
131053.explanation: The media file could not be processed.
131053.action: Check the file and send it again.

131053_notFound.title: Media file not found
131053_notFound.explanation: The file link is not accessible (404), so Meta could not download it.
131053_notFound.action: Re-upload the file and send again.

131053_invalidFile.title: Invalid media file
131053_invalidFile.explanation: The file format or size is not supported. Supported images: JPG, PNG or static WebP, up to 5MB.
131053_invalidFile.action: Convert the file to a supported format and send again.

131052.title: Customer media download failed
131052.explanation: The media file sent by the customer could not be downloaded.
131052.action: Ask the customer to send the file again.

131051.title: Unsupported message type
131051.explanation: WhatsApp does not support this message or file type.
131051.action: Send the content in a supported format, such as text, image or document.

131048.title: Spam rate limit
131048.explanation: The number's sending quality is low, so message sending was limited.
131048.action: Wait and send only relevant messages. Check the number's quality in Meta Business Manager.

131056.title: Too many messages to the same customer
131056.explanation: Too many messages were sent to the same number in a short time.
131056.action: Wait a moment and send again.

130429.title: Sending rate exceeded
130429.explanation: The number is sending more messages than allowed in a short period.
130429.action: Wait a few seconds and try again.

130472.title: Customer is in a Meta experiment
130472.explanation: The customer is part of a Meta experiment and does not receive marketing messages.
130472.action: Send a non-marketing message or try again later.

131050.title: Customer opted out of marketing
131050.explanation: The customer chose not to receive marketing messages from the business.
131050.action: Do not send marketing messages. Service messages can be sent within the 24-hour window.

131030.title: Number not in the allowed recipients list
131030.explanation: The number is not in the approved recipients list of the test account.
131030.action: Add the number to the recipients list or switch to a production account.

131031.title: Account locked
131031.explanation: The WhatsApp Business account is locked, usually due to a policy violation or missing verification.
131031.action: Contact the account manager and check the account status in Meta Business Manager.

131021.title: Recipient is the sender number
131021.explanation: A message cannot be sent to the business number itself.

131008.title: Missing or invalid parameter
131008.explanation: A value is missing from the send request or is invalid.
131008.action: Check the filled-in details and try again.

131000.title: Temporary error
131000.explanation: A general error occurred or the service is currently unavailable.
131000.action: Try again in a few minutes.

131005.title: Permission issue
131005.explanation: The account token or permissions are invalid or have expired.

132000.title: Variable count mismatch
132000.explanation: The number of filled-in variables does not match the template.
132000.action: Fill in all template variables and send again.

132001.title: Template does not exist
132001.explanation: The selected template or language does not exist or is not approved.

132005.title: Text too long
132005.explanation: The text after filling in the variables is too long.

132007.title: Format violates character policy
132007.explanation: The template content violates WhatsApp's character policy.

132012.title: Parameter format mismatch
132012.explanation: The format of one of the parameters does not match the template.
132012.action: Check the filled-in values and try again.

132015.title: Template is paused
132015.explanation: The template was paused due to low quality.
132015.action: Use a different template or wait until the pause ends.

132016.title: Template is disabled
132016.explanation: The template was disabled due to prolonged low quality.
